# Toastid Tech, LLC — llms.txt
# Company summary for AI crawlers and assistants.

## Company
Toastid Tech, LLC is an AI consulting and progressive web app (PWA) development
company founded in 2026 by Sean Sziklas Sr., a 20+ year IT operations veteran
(USGS, DIRECTV), based in Van Buren, Arkansas, USA.

It builds AI-powered progressive web apps and provides AI consulting, full
business audits, and business automation for small businesses and solopreneurs.

Tagline: "Don't Get Left Behind." Brand: dark, premium, futuristic,
electric-blue aesthetic.

- Website: https://toastidtech.com/
- About: https://toastidtech.com/about.html
- Contact: https://toastidtech.com/contact.html (info@toastidtech.com, (479) 339-1504)
- Social: https://www.youtube.com/@ToastidTechLLC,
  https://www.tiktok.com/@toastidofficial,
  https://www.instagram.com/toastidofficial

## Apps (all progressive web apps — no app store needed; install from the browser)
- Cope — "Your PRIVATE Mental Health Buddy": daily emotional wellness companion
  with grounding tools, affirmations, a 5-minute reset guide, and a 30-day
  check-in calendar. https://cope.toastidtech.com/ ($12.99/mo standalone,
  $19.99/mo with AI chat)
- BiteFact — AI meal-photo nutrition tracking with user verification before
  meals are logged. https://bitefact.toastidtech.com/ (free / Plus $12.99/mo /
  AI $19.99/mo)
- SOPilot (ToastidReady) — AI-powered SOP builder that turns how you already
  work into documentation your team can follow. https://sopilot.toastidtech.com/
  ($9.99/mo)
- Micro Habits — break big goals into 5-minute rituals ($24.99 one-time)
- CanvasFlow — graphic design PWA for creators
- 28-Day Walking Tai Chi — guided daily walking practice
- Pulse Matrix — 7-day multi-platform marketing program
